THE PROBLEM WITH HOW THIS IS PRICED TODAY

Class-average pricing can't see your building.

Most long-term care liability is still priced off state and facility-type averages, then re-rated once a year. It has no way to reward a facility that is actually run well, and it caps the coverage that matters most right when a claim gets serious.

$25K–$100K

Typical market sublimits on assault and battery, sexual abuse and molestation, and wandering and elopement claims, often inclusive of defense costs. A single serious claim can burn through the entire sublimit in legal fees before it ever reaches the injured party.

  • A&BAssault and battery is frequently sublimited far below the underlying policy limit.
  • SAMSexual abuse and molestation coverage is often the most restricted line on the policy, even though exposure is rising.
  • W&EWandering and elopement claims, common in memory care, are treated as a footnote instead of a core exposure.
  • RATINGUnderwriting happens once a year, off static data, with no way to reflect what is actually happening in the building today.
HOW QUATTRO UNDERWRITES

Two signals already inside your building, read at the facility level.

We don't ask operators to install anything new. At submission, Quattro's proprietary AI reads 90 days of the clinical and monitoring data already generated in your facility, alongside the application itself, to underwrite at the facility level instead of a state or class average.

CLINICAL SIGNAL

What your care records already show

Incident documentation, care planning activity, staffing patterns, and clinical outcomes from the systems your clinical teams already use every day, reviewed over the 90 days preceding your application.

OBSERVED SIGNAL

What's actually happening on the floor

Fall response times, supervision patterns, and safety-relevant events from the monitoring systems already installed in your facility, reviewed over that same 90-day window rather than a single self-reported snapshot.

→

Quattro's proprietary AI combines both signals into a single, facility-level risk profile used to underwrite your policy. Once bound, we keep watching both signals and send your team early-warning alerts to help prevent incidents before they happen, with that same ongoing data informing underwriting again at renewal.

No new hardware. No added burden on your clinical or facilities staff. We work with what's already running in the building.

FOR APPOINTED AGENTS AND WHOLESALE PARTNERS

A dual-line program built for a segment brokers struggle to place.

Most markets in this space write general liability only, price every account in a class the same, and offer no way to help a facility avoid a claim in the first place. Quattro is built differently on all three counts.

  • 01Early-warning alerts, not just a policy. Once bound, we monitor the same clinical and video signal we underwrote on and flag issues to your client before they become incidents, not after.
  • 02Broader coverage than the rest of the market: full limits on assault and battery, sexual abuse and molestation, and wandering and elopement, with defense costs outside the limit.
  • 03Granular, facility-level underwriting using 90 days of real facility data plus the application, instead of pricing every account in a class the same.
  • 04Combined GL and PL under one program, so your client isn't stacking policies from two markets to cover one facility.
  • 05A single point of contact through binding and into claims, so appointed agents aren't chasing down answers across teams.
Request an appointment
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Retail and wholesale brokers with active long-term care and senior living books, particularly accounts with independent or regional operators currently facing sublimit restrictions or non-renewal.

  • Skilled nursing and assisted living GL and PL renewals
  • Memory care and CCRC accounts
  • Accounts declined or non-renewed for prior loss history
  • Programs currently capped by low A&B or SAM sublimits

Step 10 of 11
Consent and supporting documents
Video and EHR data sharing consent

Quattro underwrites using 90 days of facility data leading up to this application. Before we can begin, the insured needs to review and e-sign a consent authorizing that initial access, along with ongoing access afterward for early-warning alerts and renewal underwriting. Send it now so it's already signed by the time underwriting reaches out.

Consent to share video surveillance and EHR data

By signing, the insured authorizes Quattro Insurance Services and its underwriting and reinsurance partners to receive (1) video surveillance data and electronic health record data covering the 90 days prior to the date of this application, used to underwrite this submission, and (2) video surveillance data and electronic health record data on an ongoing basis for as long as the resulting policy is in force, used to generate early-warning alerts intended to help the facility prevent incidents before they happen, and to inform underwriting again at renewal. Quattro does not use ongoing data to reprice or re-underwrite coverage during the policy period. This consent does not by itself bind or amend coverage. It may be withdrawn only in accordance with the terms of the policy once issued, and withdrawal may affect the facility's eligibility for continued coverage. This consent must be completed by a representative of the facility with authority to bind the organization. This is a summary for review purposes; the full consent and disclosure language will be presented to the insured at the time of signature.
